title: Note: Changes and Renames between recording and 1.0.0 release

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to a small update that is recorded after the normal recordings that you are about to see.
cues.zh: 大家好，這是一段補充更新，在你接下來會看到的主要課程錄製完成後才錄製。

cues.en: Because when this course was recorded, the Microsoft 18 framework were in preview,
cues.zh: 因為這門課錄製時，Microsoft Agent Framework 還在預覽階段，

cues.en: and we were to expect a few breaking changes, and those major breaking changes have now happened so far
cues.zh: 我們原本就預期會有一些不相容變更。而這些主要變更目前已經隨著

cues.en: with the release of Release Candidate 1 and 2.
cues.zh: Release Candidate 1 和 2 的推出而發生。

cues.en: So this is recorded in March, while most of the course has been recorded back in January.
cues.zh: 這段更新是在 3 月錄製，大部分課程則是在 1 月錄製的。

cues.en: So there have been a few breaking changes that, of course, is reflected in the source code repository, so that's fully up to date,
cues.zh: 這些不相容變更都已反映在原始碼儲存庫裡，因此儲存庫是最新的，

cues.en: but some of the video material will not have these things in, so that's the reason for this video.
cues.zh: 但部分影片還沒有更新，這就是我錄製這段影片的原因。

cues.en: Most of them are very small, and some of them are actually really good that have caused me to take away a few of the videos on some limitations that are now gone.
cues.zh: 大部分變更都很小，有些其實非常好，讓我得以移除幾段介紹限制的影片，因為那些限制已經不存在。

cues.en: But let's quickly look at them.
cues.zh: 現在就快速看看這些變更。

cues.en: If you are seeing this after you have seen the entire course, it's really good to know these.
cues.zh: 如果你已經看完整門課，再來看這段，了解這些內容會很有幫助。

cues.en: If you're just beginning the course, you can sort of skip this, but there will be a few things that might not be fully up
cues.zh: 如果你才剛開始，可以先略過，但 GitHub 儲存庫和影片之間可能會有一些

cues.en: one-to-one between the GitHub repository and the videos.
cues.zh: 無法完全一一對上的地方。

cues.en: So what has changed?
cues.zh: 究竟改了哪些內容呢？

cues.en: First up, a very simple change in when we create our agents.
cues.zh: 首先是建立代理程式時，一個很簡單的變更。

cues.en: In the past, and in most of the recordings, I show you Create AI Agent.
cues.zh: 以前以及大部分影片中，我示範的都是 CreateAIAgent。

cues.en: That has been renamed to As AI Agent, but beyond that, it is nothing more than a name change.
cues.zh: 現在它改名為 AsAIAgent，除此之外就只是名稱改變。

cues.en: Then there's what in the videos are called Agent Threads, are now called Agent Sessions.
cues.zh: 接著，影片裡稱為 AgentThread 的東西，現在改稱 AgentSession。

cues.en: Again, a new name, and this method GetNewThread has now become Async, but else it works mostly the same,
cues.zh: 這同樣是改名，另外 GetNewThread 這個方法現在變成非同步，但其餘使用方式大致相同，

cues.en: and the underlying changes are more advanced than this course anyway.
cues.zh: 底層的變更則比這門課的範圍更深入。

cues.en: So I will re-record a few videos in order to have this, but whenever you see in one of the older videos Agent Thread,
cues.zh: 我會重錄部分影片。不過，如果你在較舊影片中看到 AgentThread，

cues.en: it's just an Agent Session instead.
cues.zh: 把它當成現在的 AgentSession 就可以了。

cues.en: Then a very small change again.
cues.zh: 再來也是一個非常小的變更。

cues.en: Whenever we do the RunAsync method, there is, in the past, something called Agent Run Response.
cues.zh: 以前呼叫 RunAsync 時，會得到一個叫做 AgentRunResponse 的物件。

cues.en: It's now called Agent Response, so it's only a name change and nothing more.
cues.zh: 現在改名為 AgentResponse，同樣只是改名，沒有其他差別。

cues.en: And the final major change that has happened is that if you've already seen the course, you should have seen that I have shown some limitations in what is called Structured Output.
cues.zh: 最後一項主要變更是：如果你已經看過課程，應該記得我介紹過結構化輸出的一些限制。

cues.en: Those limitations are gone as of the release candidate, which is really, really good.
cues.zh: 從候選發布版開始，這些限制已經解除了，這真的非常好。

cues.en: So the first was that if you had an AI Agent and not a chat client agent, you couldn't use RunAsync with Structured Output.
cues.zh: 第一個限制是，以前如果使用 AIAgent，而不是 ChatClientAgent，就不能讓 RunAsync 使用結構化輸出。

cues.en: That has now been changed, so you can, and in the same manner, the RunAsync method can now use list of something, array of something,
cues.zh: 現在已經可以了。同樣地，RunAsync 方法現在也能直接使用某種型別的 List 或陣列，

cues.en: instead of needing a complete object.
cues.zh: 不再一定要包成完整的物件。

cues.en: That has also been changed.
cues.zh: 這一點也已經變更。

cues.en: So those are the four major changes.
cues.zh: 以上就是四項主要變更。

cues.en: Again, I will tweak a few of the videos, but a few of them will still say Create AI Agent and Agent Run Response,
cues.zh: 再次說明，我會調整部分影片，但有些影片仍會提到 CreateAIAgent 和 AgentRunResponse，

cues.en: because those two changes don't justify a complete re-recording of the course.
cues.zh: 因為這兩個名稱的變更，不值得為此重錄整門課。

cues.en: So I hope you can see past these few changes, and on with the course.
cues.zh: 希望這幾項小變更不會造成困擾，接下來繼續上課吧。
